entries.aka: physical therapy (PT); physiotherapy; physical therapist / physiotherapist
entries.def: 物理治療是由物理治療師評估身體狀況，再用運動等多種方法治療；也會教您學會自己在家運動。
entries.example: 例如設計伸展、肌力、有氧運動計畫，並教會正確動作
entries.note: 在僵直性脊椎炎，物理治療有助維持或改善脊椎活動、增進體能，並減輕疼痛。
entries.label: ACR 2022・定義

evidence.quote: In these recommendations, comprehensive refers to the numerous different approaches and interventions that occupational therapists and physical therapists utilize in the assessment and management of people with RA.
evidence.location: Results, Rehabilitation recommendations (comprehensive OT and PT)
evidence.supports: def: 物理治療師評估並用多種方法治療

evidence.quote: Because one of the goals of physical therapy is to educate patients in self-management in using an independent exercise program, the panel judged that active interventions should be stressed over passive interventions.
evidence.location: Recommendations A2 Rehabilitation (active AS), Evidence and rationale
evidence.supports: def: 教您學會自己運動

evidence.quote: Physical therapy in stable patients was most important for periodic reassessment and appropriate modifications of home exercises.
evidence.location: Recommendations B2 Rehabilitation (stable AS), Evidence and rationale
evidence.supports: def: 在家運動（居家運動的定期評估與調整）

evidence.quote: The recommendation is conditional in that unsupervised back exercises should not substitute for initial instruction in back exercises by a physical therapist.
evidence.supports: example: 教會正確動作

evidence.quote: The Voting Panel and patient panel emphasized the importance of appropriate prescription and supervision of resistance exercise by physical therapists or other qualified exercise professionals to prevent harm.
evidence.supports: example: 肌力訓練由物理治療師安排與指導

evidence.quote: Evaluation and treatment by a physical therapist. Components of PT services will vary and should include exercise.
evidence.location: Table 1 (Descriptions and examples of interventions), row: Comprehensive physical therapy [WebFetch of the PMC table page pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC10947582/table/T1/; the get_full_text_article output omits Table 1]
evidence.supports: def: 評估與治療、內容應包含運動 (2 consistent segmented passes)

evidence.quote: May also include functional training and physical activity, energy conservation, workplace accommodations, mobility and gait training, manual therapy, self-management education, electrotherapy, application of orthoses, instruction in assistive devices, pain-management including thermal therapy.
evidence.location: Table 1 (Descriptions and examples of interventions), row: Comprehensive physical therapy [WebFetch of the PMC table page pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC10947582/table/T1/; the get_full_text_article output omits Table 1]
evidence.supports: def: 多種方法 (2 consistent segmented passes)

evidence.quote: Refer people with axial spondyloarthritis to a specialist physiotherapist to start an individualised, structured exercise programme, which should include: stretching, strengthening and postural exercises; deep breathing; spinal extension; range of motion exercises for the lumbar, thoracic and cervical sections of the spine; aerobic exercise.
evidence.supports: example: 設計伸展、肌力、有氧運動計畫 (matches research-phase reading in research/axspa.md C21)

evidence.quote: Physiotherapy is an important treatment to maintain or improve movement in the spine, improve fitness and decrease pain.
evidence.location: Plain language summary (PMC record of the Cochrane review)
evidence.supports: note: 維持或改善脊椎活動、體能，減輕疼痛

entries.confidence: High (PMC full text or abstract, Tier 1–2)
entries.reviewer_notes: Confidence basis: def rests on PMC-verified ACR 2022/2015 text (Tier 1); Table 1 and NICE quotes (WebFetch) are supplementary. No guideline gives a one-sentence professional definition of physical therapy; the def is built from what ACR 2022/ACR 2015 say physical therapists do (PMC-verified) plus ACR Table 1 (WebFetch, PMC table page, 2 consistent passes). The site uses 物理治療師 for both NICE's 'specialist physiotherapist' and ACR's 'physical therapist'; the research notes record that ASAS-EULAR changed 'physical therapy' to 'physiotherapy' in its 2022 update (research/axspa.md C42), i.e. the two words are used for the same intervention. Note is AS-specific (Cochrane 2008, search to Jan 2007). PubMed lists NICE NG65 as a book record (PMID 28350428 found by search; get_article_metadata returned no record; another 2017 NICE spondyloarthritis record, PMID 32049469, also exists) - please confirm the PMID. The site also uses 物理治療師 in axspa-exercise-sum, which is not in the context file.

entries.def: 職能治療是由職能治療師評估和治療，幫助您以較少的疼痛完成穿衣、煮飯、打掃、工作等日常生活的事。
entries.example: 例如教關節保護與節省體力、提供副木、指導使用輔具
entries.note: 職能治療師也能提供與工作場所有關的建議和資源。
entries.label: ACR 2022・定義

evidence.quote: Occupational therapy (OT), with the aim to facilitate task performance and to decrease the consequences of rheumatoid arthritis for daily life activities, is considered to be a cornerstone in the management of rheumatoid arthritis.
evidence.supports: def: 幫助完成日常生活的事

evidence.quote: People with rheumatoid arthritis can find it difficult to do daily chores such as dressing, cooking, cleaning and working. Occupational therapists can give advice on how to do every day activities with less pain or advice on how to use splints and assistive devices.
evidence.location: Plain language summary (PMC record of the Cochrane review)
evidence.supports: def: 以較少疼痛完成穿衣、煮飯、打掃、工作; example: 副木、輔具

evidence.quote: To determine whether OT interventions (classified as comprehensive therapy, training of motor function, training of skills, instruction on joint protection and energy conservation, counseling, instruction about assistive devices and provision of splints) for rheumatoid arthritis patients improve outcome on functional ability, social participation and/or health related quality of life.
evidence.supports: example: 關節保護、節省體力、提供副木、指導使用輔具

evidence.quote: In these recommendations, comprehensive refers to the numerous different approaches and interventions that occupational therapists and physical therapists utilize in the assessment and management of people with RA.
evidence.location: Results, Rehabilitation recommendations (comprehensive OT and PT)
evidence.supports: def: 評估和治療

evidence.quote: Evaluation and treatment by Occupational Therapist with the goal of increasing physical function and participation.
evidence.location: Table 1 (Descriptions and examples of interventions), row: Comprehensive occupational therapy [WebFetch of the PMC table page pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC10947582/table/T1/; the get_full_text_article output omits Table 1]
evidence.supports: def: 評估和治療 (2 consistent passes)

evidence.quote: Components of OT services vary and may include arthritis education, ADL evaluation and training, joint protection, activity pacing, work simplification and fatigue management, exercise (particularly for the hand and arm), splinting/orthotics, provision of assistive/adaptive devices, environmental adaptations, work and leisure counselling/rehabilitation, work-site assessment, sexual advice, relaxation, and pain and stress management training.
evidence.location: Table 1 (Descriptions and examples of interventions), row: Comprehensive occupational therapy [WebFetch of the PMC table page pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC10947582/table/T1/; the get_full_text_article output omits Table 1]
evidence.supports: example (supplementary; 2 consistent segmented passes)

evidence.quote: Early referral to these services can provide education to people with RA on ways to independently use these interventions (e.g., exercise, joint protection, energy conservation, assistive and adaptive devices) to self-manage their disease.
evidence.supports: example: 關節保護、節省體力、輔具 (OT and PT services)

evidence.quote: Occupational therapists and occupational health experts can provide helpful advice and resources in relation to the workplace.
evidence.supports: note: 工作場所相關建議與資源

sources.citation: Steultjens EM, et al. Occupational therapy for rheumatoid arthritis. Cochrane Database Syst Rev 2004;(1):CD003114.

sources.citation: Nikiphorou E, et al. 2021 EULAR recommendations for the implementation of self-management strategies in patients with inflammatory arthritis. Ann Rheum Dis 2021;80(10):1278-1285.

entries.reviewer_notes: Confidence basis: the 'daily activities' core of the def comes from a Cochrane review (Tier 3, PMC-verified) and ACR Table 1 (Tier 1, WebFetch, 2 passes); the example is also supported by PMC-verified ACR text. The Cochrane OT review is old (published 2004, last search December 2002); it is used only to describe what OT is and does, not for efficacy. ACR Table 1 definition read via WebFetch (2 consistent passes). The alias 職能或物理治療師 also belongs conceptually to physical-therapy; check how the glossary tool handles overlapping aliases.

entries.def: 手部治療師是專門評估手部問題的治療師，通常是受過額外訓練的職能或物理治療師，可依您的需要設計手部運動的方式和強度。
entries.note: 指引舉例的資格是「認證手部治療師」（CHT）。
entries.label: ACR 2022・說明

evidence.quote: Evaluation of the unique needs of the person with RA with hand involvement is best performed by an experienced hand therapist (e.g., a certified hand therapist (CHT) who is typically an occupational or physical therapist with additional training) who can guide the specific design and intensity of the intervention.
evidence.supports: def (all parts) and note (CHT)

evidence.quote: For patients with hand involvement, performing hand therapy exercises is conditionally recommended over no hand therapy exercises.
evidence.supports: context: site sentence RA-2.1

sources.short: ACR 2022 類風濕性關節炎運動、復健、飲食與整合療法指引（美國的風濕病醫學會）

entries.confidence: High (PMC full text or abstract, Tier 1–2)
entries.reviewer_notes: Confidence basis: single PMC-verified ACR 2022 sentence (Tier 1). Matches the site wording 多為受過進階訓練的職能或物理治療師 ('typically ... with additional training'). The source gives CHT only as an example; it does not say whether this credential exists in Taiwan, so the note does not claim it.

entries.def: 關節保護是一種自我管理方法：改變做事方式和受影響關節的動作，以減少疼痛、發炎和關節負擔，幫助維持身體功能。
entries.example: 例如改變做事方式以避免疼痛、休息、改用其他肌群
entries.note: 最好向職能或物理治療師學習正確的做法。
entries.label: ACR 2022・定義

evidence.quote: Self-management approach that aims to maintain function by providing people with ways to alter work methods and movement patterns of affected joints to reduce pain, inflammation, and joint stress. Examples include changing the way of performing activities to avoid pain, resting, using alternative muscle groups.
evidence.location: Table 1 (Descriptions and examples of interventions), row: Joint protection techniques [WebFetch of the PMC table page pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC10947582/table/T1/; the get_full_text_article output omits Table 1]
evidence.supports: def and example (2 consistent segmented passes this session; identical to the research-phase reading of the author manuscript in research/ra.md RA-C39)

evidence.quote: The Voting Panel also stressed the importance of proper patient education in joint protection techniques by occupational or physical therapists.
evidence.supports: note

evidence.quote: Use of joint protection techniques is conditionally recommended over no joint protection techniques.
evidence.supports: context: site sentence RA-2.2

entries.reviewer_notes: Confidence basis: Tier 1 definition read via WebFetch (PMC table page, 2 passes) and identical to the research-phase reading of the author manuscript; note is PMC-verified. The definition is in ACR Table 1, which get_full_text_article does not return. Please spot-check the Table 1 wording against the PMC page. The site's examples (RA-2.2) match Table 1 exactly.

entries.def: 副木、護具與矯具是用來支撐、矯正肌肉和骨骼的功能，改善關節排列或保護關節的器具。
entries.example: 例如手腕或手指副木、足部或膝部矯具、加壓手套、貼紮
entries.note: 不用處方也買得到，但指引建議由有經驗的職能或物理治療師協助挑選和調整。
entries.label: ACR 2022・定義

evidence.quote: Devices to correct and support musculoskeletal function, improve joint alignment, or protect the joint. Examples include wrist and finger splints, foot or knee orthoses, compression gloves, taping.
evidence.location: Table 1 (Descriptions and examples of interventions), row: Bracing and orthoses [WebFetch of the PMC table page pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC10947582/table/T1/; the get_full_text_article output omits Table 1]
evidence.supports: def and example (2 consistent passes)

evidence.quote: In addition, although these interventions are available without a prescription, the Voting Panel recommends their prescription and use under the guidance of an experienced occupational therapist or physical therapist to ensure appropriate item selection and fit.
evidence.supports: note

evidence.quote: For patients with hand and/or wrist involvement and/or deformity, use of splinting, orthoses, and/or compression is conditionally recommended over no splinting, orthoses, and/or compression.
evidence.supports: context: site sentence RA-2.3 (hand/wrist)

evidence.quote: For patients with foot and/or ankle involvement, use of bracing, orthoses, and/or taping is conditionally recommended over no bracing, orthoses, and/or compression.
evidence.supports: context: site sentence RA-2.3 (foot/ankle); example 貼紮

evidence.quote: For patients with knee involvement, use of bracing and/or orthoses is conditionally recommended over no bracing and/or orthoses.
evidence.supports: context: site sentence RA-2.3 (knee)

entries.reviewer_notes: Confidence basis: Tier 1 definition read via WebFetch (2 passes); note is PMC-verified. Table 1 has one combined row, 'Bracing and orthoses'. The Chinese mapping (splint = 副木, brace = 護具, orthosis = 矯具) follows the site and should be checked by the physician. The context file lists only the alias 副木, but 護具 and 矯具 also appear in RA-2.3; they were not added as aliases, to avoid unintended matches. The foot/ankle statement lists 'taping' in the intervention but 'compression' in the comparator (source inconsistency, already noted in research/ra.md).

entries.aka: assistive devices (mobility); adaptive equipment (daily living); assistive technology
entries.def: 輔具是用來增加或維持身體功能的用品，可幫助行動或完成日常生活中的活動。
entries.example: 例如拐杖、助行器、長柄或加粗握把用具、取物夾
entries.note: 居家環境調整（如扶手、加高馬桶座）也能提升安全。
entries.label: ACR 2022・定義

evidence.quote: Assistive technology is any item used to increase or maintain functional ability in individuals with disabilities. It includes a wide range of products, from low‐technology devices to technologically complex equipment.
evidence.location: Abstract, Background (text as displayed in the PMC record, which uses the hyphen character U+2010 in low‐technology)
evidence.supports: def: 增加或維持身體功能的用品

evidence.quote: Devices to assist with mobility. Examples include crutches, canes, walkers, wheelchairs, tricycles, scooters.
evidence.location: Table 1 (Descriptions and examples of interventions), row: Assistive devices [WebFetch of the PMC table page pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC10947582/table/T1/; the get_full_text_article output omits Table 1]
evidence.supports: def: 幫助行動; example: 拐杖、助行器 (2 passes; matches research/ra.md RA-C49)

evidence.quote: Devices to assist with activities of daily living. Examples include built up and/or long handled equipment, sock aide, button hook, reachers, pill cutters, cell phone holders.
evidence.location: Table 1 (Descriptions and examples of interventions), row: Adaptive equipment [WebFetch of the PMC table page pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC10947582/table/T1/; the get_full_text_article output omits Table 1]
evidence.supports: def: 日常生活活動; example: 長柄或加粗握把用具、取物夾 (2 passes; matches research/ra.md RA-C50)

evidence.quote: Adapting environment to improve safety. Examples include adaptations for toileting (raised toilet seat, commode, toilet safety rail), showering (tub seat, handheld shower, walk in bath), grab bars, ramps, stair lifts, home modification.
evidence.location: Table 1 (Descriptions and examples of interventions), row: Environmental adaptations [WebFetch of the PMC table page pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC10947582/table/T1/; the get_full_text_article output omits Table 1]
evidence.supports: note: 扶手、加高馬桶座 (2 passes; matches research/ra.md RA-C51)

evidence.quote: In the absence of evidence addressing these PICO questions, a conditional recommendation was made in favor of using assistive devices/equipment because of the potential for meaningfully improving function and quality of life and the lack of known harms.
evidence.location: Results, Rehabilitation recommendations (assistive devices, adaptive equipment, environmental adaptations)
evidence.supports: context: site sentence RA-2.4

sources.short: Cochrane 2009 類風濕性關節炎輔具系統性回顧
sources.citation: Tuntland H, et al. Assistive technology for rheumatoid arthritis. Cochrane Database Syst Rev 2009;(4):CD006729.

entries.reviewer_notes: Confidence basis: def from a Cochrane abstract (Tier 3); examples and note from ACR Table 1 via WebFetch (2 passes, identical to research-phase reading). ACR splits these into three items: assistive devices (mobility), adaptive equipment (daily-living tools) and environmental adaptations (home safety). The site groups the first two under 輔具 and mentions 扶手 (grab bars, an environmental adaptation) separately, which is consistent. 拐杖 covers both crutches and canes. ACR found no eligible evidence for these questions (conditional recommendations).

entries.aka: activity pacing; energy conservation; activity modification; fatigue management; activity management (planning, prioritizing, pacing)
entries.def: 指在活動和休息之間取得平衡，讓自己能完成要做的活動；包括調整活動節奏、節省體力、改變活動方式和處理疲倦的技巧。
entries.example: 例如事先規劃、排出優先順序、調整步調
entries.note: 目前研究證據很少，但一般認為安全；可請職能或物理治療師指導。
entries.label: ACR 2022・定義

evidence.quote: Balancing activity and rest to accomplish activities. Includes activity pacing, energy conservation, activity modification, fatigue management techniques.
evidence.location: Table 1 (Descriptions and examples of interventions), row: Activity pacing [WebFetch of the PMC table page pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC10947582/table/T1/; the get_full_text_article output omits Table 1]
evidence.supports: def (2 passes; identical to research-phase reading in research/ra.md RA-C58)

evidence.quote: We recommend an individualized holistic review for those with fatigue focusing on activity management (for example planning, prioritizing, pacing), sleep quality and lifestyle (2, C) (SOA 96.7%).
evidence.supports: example: 事先規劃、排出優先順序、調整步調 (site sentence SJ-4.2)

evidence.quote: There was no evidence found for this PICO question. However, these interventions are generally safe and may help preserve physical function and manage fatigue. Proper instruction in these approaches by occupational or physical therapists as well as periodic reminders to employ them were suggested by the Patient Panel and Voting Panel.
evidence.location: Results, Rehabilitation recommendations (activity pacing, energy conservation)
evidence.supports: note

evidence.quote: Use of activity pacing, energy conservation, activity modification, and/or fatigue management is conditionally recommended over no activity pacing, energy conservation, activity modification, and/or fatigue management.
evidence.supports: aka; context: site sentence RA-5.1

sources.short: BSR 2025 乾燥症指引（英國的風濕病學會）
sources.citation: Price EJ, et al. British Society for Rheumatology guideline on management of adult and juvenile onset Sjögren disease. Rheumatology (Oxford) 2025;64(2):409-439.

entries.reviewer_notes: Confidence basis: Tier 1 definition via WebFetch (2 passes plus research-phase reading); example (BSR 2025) and note (ACR) are PMC-verified. One small cross-sectional RA study (Cuperus N et al. Clin Rehabil 2012;26:1048-52, PMID 22327885) found activity pacing associated with lower physical activity. This was not added to the note (single small study), but it supports the site's separate advice to keep exercising.

entries.def: 自我管理是自己處理症狀、治療、生活習慣改變，以及疾病對心理與社會影響的能力；自我管理課程是引導您做到這些的標準化課程。
entries.example: 課程可包括疾病衛教、學習解決問題和設定目標
entries.note: 自我管理不是要您獨自面對，最好有醫療人員、病友團體和家人支持。
entries.label: EULAR 2021・定義

evidence.quote: self-management is defined as ‘the ability of the individual to manage symptoms, treatment, lifestyle changes and psychosocial and cultural consequences of health conditions’
evidence.supports: def: 自我管理的能力

evidence.quote: In this definition, two major components were highlighted: (1) self-management is aimed at achieving independence and (2) ideally, self-management should be supported by others, for example, HCPs, patient organisations and family.
evidence.supports: note

entries.reviewer_notes: Confidence basis: all quotes PMC-verified, but the technical description (end of range, audible crack) comes from a BMJ systematic review (Tier 3); 'high-velocity thrust' and the note are Tier 1 (ACR 2015). Rubinstein's 'SMT' covers both manipulation and the gentler mobilisation; 扳動手法 corresponds to manipulation (high-velocity thrust), which is what ACR 2015 recommends against. Scope differs by source: ACR 2015 strongly against only with spinal fusion or advanced spinal osteoporosis; TRA 2020 says avoid any spinal manipulation in axSpA; ACR 2022 conditionally against chiropractic for RA (the PMC text drops the word 'against' from the statement, but 'not' is retained in the rationale quoted here). The PMC text of the TRA sentence ends '...techniques common in.' (word lost), so it was quoted only up to 'risk involved'. The 2019 BMJ review is about chronic low back pain; it is used only for the technical description of manipulation.

entries.reviewer_notes: Confidence basis: definition is the Institute of Medicine wording quoted in a PMC-verified Cochrane CAM Field paper (second-hand); note from NICE NG100 via WebFetch (matching research-phase reading). This is a definition of 'complementary and alternative medicine'; NICE uses 'complementary therapies' without defining it (WebFetch check of NG100). Wieland 2011 lists acupuncture, homeopathy, herbal medicine, traditional Chinese medicine and chiropractic as CAM from a US/European perspective.
